hypothesis: H1 (world models): an agent that learned a world model of its home can keep acting when observation is removed — dead reckoning through the model, sharpened by a learned touch (bump) likelihood — but the same machinery fails in a stranger's home; and model-based Dyna dominates model-free Q-learning on sample efficiency.

claims.claim: dyna-beats-q: DynaQ reaches 90% eval success in fewer env steps than sample-matched (update-unmatched) Q-learning
claims.evidence: t90 IQM dynaq 2562 vs qlearning 25500 (censored 0%/0%); MW p_holm 7.34e-11, Welch p_holm 7.32e-31

claims.claim: dyna-advantage-is-model-not-updates: the Dyna speedup survives an update-matched replay baseline (ReplayQ, 20 replayed updates per real step; van Hasselt 2019)
claims.evidence: t90 IQM: qlearning 25500, replayq 2500, dynaq 2562; replay closes 100% of the Dyna advantage; dyna_vs_replay MW p 0.548 (p_holm 0.548, Welch p_holm 0.318); replay_faster_than_q MW p_holm 7.34e-11

claims.claim: pure-dead-reckoning-works-at-home: blind-A stays >= 0.8x sighted-A (DESIGN v1's literal prediction, scored honestly; refuted below 0.5x, boundary between)
touch-filtered-blind-works-at-home: blind-A-touch stays >= 0.8x sighted-A (refuted below 0.5x, boundary between)
stranger-collapse: judged on the symmetric touch pair — the same blind+touch machinery falls far below home performance in HOME_B (<= 0.5x home), modestly above a matched random floor
claims.evidence: success IQM blind-A-touch 0.975 vs blind-B-touch 0.290 (MW p_holm 1.49e-09, Welch p_holm 6.73e-18); random floors: random-B 0.033 (matched), random-A 0.000 (cross-home); blind-B 0.075 vs matched floor MW p 0.00399, blind-B-touch vs matched floor MW p 5.53e-11

claims.claim: touch-helps-at-home: bump filtering beats pure dead reckoning in HOME_A
claims.evidence: success IQM blind-A-touch 0.975 vs blind-A 0.204; MW p_holm 1.49e-09, Welch p_holm 1.4e-18

conclusion.summary: t90 to 90% eval success (IQM env steps): dynaq 2562, update-matched replayq 2500, qlearning 25500 (censored 0%/0%/0%). HOME_A blindfold success IQM: sighted 0.97, pure blind 0.20, blind+touch 0.98. Stranger HOME_B, same machinery: blind+touch 0.29, pure blind 0.07, vs matched random-B floor 0.03 (cross-home random-A 0.00) — registered claim: far below home performance, modestly above a matched random floor (verdict: supported). Verdicts: dyna-beats-q=supported; dyna-advantage-is-model-not-updates=refuted; pure-dead-reckoning-works-at-home=refuted; touch-filtered-blind-works-at-home=supported; stranger-collapse=supported; touch-helps-at-home=supported.
